## Pull request overview This PR adds an export command for backing up Headscale configuration data, includes fixes for pointer handling in batcher tests, adds TaggedDevices pseudo-user support in the ListUsers API, and adds unrelated Git documentation. The PR title "Copilot/lataa kaikki" contains Finnish text meaning "download all" or "load all". **Changes:** - New `headscale export` command to export users, nodes, API keys, and preauth keys in JSON/YAML format - ListUsers API now includes TaggedDevices pseudo-user when tagged nodes exist - Fixed pointer handling in batcher tests (converting from direct slice iteration to index-based with pointer creation) ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | mkdocs.yml | Added navigation entry for Git commands documentation | | integration/cli_test.go | Added integration test for export command (JSON format only) | | hscontrol/mapper/batcher_test.go | Fixed loop iteration to use pointers correctly (range index pattern) | | hscontrol/grpcv1_test.go | Added comprehensive test for TaggedDevices inclusion in ListUsers | | hscontrol/grpcv1.go | Modified ListUsers to conditionally include TaggedDevices pseudo-user | | docs/usage/getting-started.md | Added documentation for export command usage | | docs/ref/git-commands.md | Added 413-line Git tutorial (unrelated to export feature) | | cmd/headscale/cli/export.go | Implemented new export CLI command | | .github/agents/my-agent.agent.md | Added incomplete agent template file (unrelated) |
